description: This file is a shell script that sets up a test environment for Git commands, including testing relative and absolute paths for git add, git rm, git ls-files, git commit, git log, and git blame operations. It contains a series of automated test cases that verify behavior with complex path handling, especially in relation to paths outside the work tree.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files for equality, typically test output against expected results.
